response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile software craftsman with deep experience in web, mobile, and backend systems (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, JavaScript), but the role requires 8-12 years of dedicated, hands-on C++/STL architecture and development for industrial automation, IoT, and secure embedded systems. His C++ exposure is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint at National Instruments and an old university project, with no recent or substantial C++ work, no message-broker/MQTT/REST IoT experience, no IEC 62443 or SDL security background, and no industrial protocol exposure.
strengths: 18+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many stacks
Demonstrated architecture, mentoring, and technical communication skills (talks, workshops, open-source projects)
Experience with distributed/event-driven systems and high-performance async I/O (DLang at Sociomantic)
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (~6 months, over a decade ago), not the 8-12 years of C++ depth required
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.), or IoT/automation domain background

key_factors.factor: Lack of substantial recent C++ expertise
No IoT/MQTT/industrial protocol or automation domain experience
